newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch voodoo babies said to be aborted foetuses.
newsitem.headline: Dutch voodoo babies said to be aborted foetuses.

text.p: The mummified infant remains at the heart of a case linking suspected murder, rape and voodoo rituals were those of foetuses and not full-term babies, ANP news agency reported on Wednesday.

Dutch police are holding a 45-year-old man on charges relating to rape and aiding child murder after the discovery in Amsterdam last week of the mummified parts of four babies, some of which were stuffed inside plastic voodoo dolls.

ANP on Wednesday quoted Humphrey Jap a Joe, the man's lawyer, as saying pathologists had establisehd the foetuses were of different ages but none were full-term. Jap a Joe was not available for comment.
Neither police nor the justice ministry would comment on the remarks or reports elsewhere that the foetuses could have come from illegal abortions allegedly carried out by the man.
Police discovered the remains last week when they searched the home of the man, accused of raping a girl whose 44-year-old mother died in suspicious circumstances last May.
